012public class IrUtil {

014    private IrUtil() {

016
017    public static Integer getConstant(IrIntArrayExpr is, int index) {
018        Domain domain = is.getDomains()[index];
019        return domain.isConstant() ? domain.getLowBound() : null;
020    }
021
022    public static int[] getConstant(IrIntExpr[] is) {
023        if (is.length == 0) {
024            return new int[0];
025        }
026        if (is[0].getDomain().isConstant()) {
027            int[] constant = new int[is.length];
028            constant[0] = is[0].getDomain().getLowBound();
029            for (int i = 1; i < is.length; i++) {
030                if (is[i].getDomain().isConstant()) {
031                    constant[i] = is[i].getDomain().getLowBound();
032                } else {
033                    return null;
034                }
035            }
036            return constant;
037        }
038        return null;
039    }
040
041    public static IrIntExpr asConstant(IrIntExpr i) {
042        return i.isConstant() ? Irs.constant(i.getLowBound()) : i;
043    }
044
045    public static IrSetExpr asConstant(IrSetExpr s) {
046        return s.isConstant() ? Irs.constant(s.getKer()) : s;
047    }
048
049    public static IrIntExpr asInt(IrSetExpr set) {
050        if (set instanceof IrSingleton) {
051            return ((IrSingleton) set).getValue();
052        }
053        if (set.isConstant() && set.getKer().isConstant()) {
054            return Irs.constant(set.getKer().getLowBound());
055        }
056        return null;
057    }
058
059    public static IrIntExpr[] asInts(IrSetArrayExpr sets) {
060        if (sets.length() == 0) {
061            return new IrIntExpr[0];
062        }
063        if (sets instanceof IrSetArrayVar) {
064            return asInts(((IrSetArrayVar) sets).getArray());
065        }
066        return null;
067    }
068
069    public static IrIntExpr[] asInts(IrSetExpr[] sets) {
070        if (sets.length == 0) {
071            return new IrIntExpr[0];
072        }
073        IrIntExpr asInt = asInt(sets[0]);
074        if (asInt == null) {
075            return null;
076        }
077        IrIntExpr[] ints = new IrIntExpr[sets.length];
078        ints[0] = asInt;
079        for (int i = 1; i < sets.length; i++) {
080            asInt = asInt(sets[i]);
081            if (asInt == null) {
082                return null;
083            }
084            ints[i] = asInt;
085        }
086        return ints;
087    }
088
089    public static IrIntExpr[] asArray(IrIntArrayExpr array) {
090        // TODO: remove
091        if (array instanceof IrIntArrayVar) {
092            return ((IrIntArrayVar) array).getArray();
093        }
094        IrIntExpr[] asArray = new IrIntExpr[array.length()];
095        for (int i = 0; i < asArray.length; i++) {
096            asArray[i] = Irs.get(array, i);
097        }
098        return asArray;
099    }

101    public static IrSetExpr[] asArray(IrSetArrayExpr array) {
102        if (array instanceof IrSetArrayVar) {
103            return ((IrSetArrayVar) array).getArray();
104        }
105        IrSetExpr[] asArray = new IrSetExpr[array.length()];
106        for (int i = 0; i < asArray.length; i++) {
107            asArray[i] = Irs.get(array, i);
108        }
109        return asArray;
110    }

112    public static IrStringExpr asConstant(IrStringExpr s) {
113        if (s.getLength().size() != 1) {
114            return s;
115        }
116        int length = s.getLength().getLowBound();
117        char[] string = new char[length];
118        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
119            if (s.getChars()[i].size() != 1) {
120                return s;
121            }
122            int chari = s.getChars()[i].getLowBound();
123            if (chari < Character.MIN_VALUE
124                    || chari > Character.MAX_VALUE
125                    || chari == 0) {
126                return s;
127            }
128            string[i] = (char) chari;
129        }
130        for (int i = length; i < s.getChars().length; i++) {
131            if (s.getChars()[i].size() != 1
132                    || s.getChars()[i].getLowBound() != 0) {
133                return s;
134            }
135        }
136        return Irs.constant(new String(string));
137    }
138
139    public static int maxLength(IrStringExpr... strings) {
140        int maxLength = 0;
141        for (IrStringExpr string : strings) {
142            maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, string.getChars().length);
143        }
144        return maxLength;
145    }
146
147    public static Ordering compare(IrIntExpr a, IrIntExpr b) {
148        if (a.equals(b)) {
149            return Ordering.EQ;
150        }
151        Domain da = a.getDomain();
152        Domain db = b.getDomain();
153        if (da.isConstant() && db.isConstant() && da.getLowBound() == db.getLowBound()) {
154            return Ordering.EQ;
155        }
156        int aLb = da.getLowBound();
157        int aUb = da.getHighBound();
158        int bLb = db.getLowBound();
159        int bUb = db.getHighBound();
160        if (aLb > bUb) {
161            return Ordering.GT;
162        }
163        if (aLb >= bUb) {
164            return Ordering.GE;
165        }
166        if (aUb < bLb) {
167            return Ordering.LT;
168        }
169        if (aUb <= bLb) {
170            return Ordering.LE;
171        }
172        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
173    }
174
175    public static Ordering compareString(IrIntExpr[] a, IrIntExpr[] b) {
176        return compareString(a, b, 0);
177    }
178
179    public static Ordering compareString(IrIntExpr[] a, IrIntExpr[] b, int index) {
180        if (index == a.length) {
181            return a.length == b.length ? Ordering.EQ : Ordering.LT;
182        }
183        if (index == b.length) {
184            assert a.length != b.length;
185            return Ordering.GT;
186        }
187        Ordering ord = compare(a[index], b[index]);
188        switch (ord) {
189            case EQ:
190                return compareString(a, b, index + 1);
191            case LE:
192                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
193                    case LT:
194                        return Ordering.LT;
195                    case LE:
196                    case EQ:
197                        return Ordering.LE;
198                    default:
199                        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
200                }
201            case GE:
202                switch (compareString(a, b, index + 1)) {
203                    case GT:
204                        return Ordering.GT;
205                    case GE:
206                    case EQ:
207                        return Ordering.GE;
208                    default:
209                        return Ordering.UNKNOWN;
210                }
211            default:
212                return ord;
213        }
214    }
215
216    public static IrIntExpr[] pad(IrIntExpr[] chars, int length) {
217        if (length < chars.length) {
218            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
219        }
220        if (length == chars.length) {
221            return chars;
222        }
223        IrIntExpr[] pad = Arrays.copyOf(chars, length);
224        Arrays.fill(pad, chars.length, pad.length, Irs.Zero);
225        return pad;
226    }
227
228    public static Set<IrVar> getVariables(IrBoolExpr constraint) {
229        Set<IrVar> variables = new HashSet<>();
230        constraint.accept(VariableFinder, variables);
231        return variables;
232    }
233
234    public static enum Ordering {
235
236        LT,
237        LE,
238        GT,
239        GE,
240        EQ,
241        UNKNOWN;
242    }
243
244    private static final IrTraverser<Set<IrVar>> VariableFinder
245            = new IrTraverser<Set<IrVar>>() {
246
247                @Override
248                public Void visit(IrBoolVar ir, Set<IrVar> a) {
249                    a.add(ir);
250                    return super.visit(ir, a);
251                }
252
253                @Override
254                public Void visit(IrIntVar ir, Set<IrVar> a) {
255                    a.add(ir);
256                    return super.visit(ir, a);
257                }
258
259                @Override
260                public Void visit(IrSetVar ir, Set<IrVar> a) {
261                    a.add(ir);
262                    return super.visit(ir, a);
263                }
264
265                @Override
266                public Void visit(IrStringVar ir, Set<IrVar> a) {
267                    a.add(ir);
268                    return super.visit(ir, a);
269                }
270            };
271}
